messages:
rachael: quick postmortem follow-up from tonight's surge. short window of TLS mismatches during cross-region route flip caused retry amplification. collecting owners.
ben: can you drop the minimal timeline/logs?
rachael: ```
2026-03-29T23:11:02Z route-flip start -> us-west-2 -> eu-west-3
2026-03-29T23:11:03Z backend-euw sidecar served cert CN=staging
2026-03-29T23:11:04Z clients retried -> 502/504 spike ~40s
``` 
omar: initial triage: cert propagation lag + immediate flip + edge retry knob. also noticed LB healthcheck TTL mismatch for the new target group.
lina: mitigation suggestions: 1) add cert-ready gating before route switch 2) add 8s cooldown after flip 3) cap edge retries with jitter
rachael: agreed. temporary actions: (A) patch edge retry cap to max_retries=3 + jitter (B) increase healthcheck timeout during flip window (5s->12s) (C) add cooldown in flip script
ben: i'll own the flip-script cooldown and healthcheck tweak. ETA: 2026-03-30 02:00 UTC. PR coming.
omar: i'll own cert-ready gating prototype in orchestrator. ETA: 2026-04-06 18:00 UTC. will test in staging first.
lina: i'll add dashboards: tls.handshake.fail by region, retry amplification metric, and alert at >0.4% for 5m. ETA: 2026-03-30 12:00 UTC.
infra-oncall: prefer low-traffic window 02:00-04:00 UTC for changes. will monitor and page if post-deploy TLS errors >0.3% for 5m.
deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance window 2026-03-30T02:00:00Z -> 2026-03-30T03:00:00Z
rachael: owners + deadlines recorded in PM doc: https://docs.internal/postmortems/2026-03-29-routing-tls-retry. please update when done.
- ben: flip-script cooldown + healthcheck change \u2024 ETA 2026-03-30 02:00 UTC
- omar: cert-ready gating prototype \u2024 ETA 2026-04-06 18:00 UTC
- lina: dashboards/alerts + runbook snippet \u2024 ETA 2026-03-30 12:00 UTC
- infra-oncall: coordinate window + verify metrics \u2024 ETA 2026-03-30 04:00 UTC
ben: PR opened -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/542. added rollback and test checklist.
omar: staging gating test green; will schedule canary promote after infra window.
lina: dashboards staged; alert rules added to staging and will promote after deploy.
rachael: recurring-pattern note: saw similar small flaps on 2026-02-11 and 2026-01-08. adding 90-day incident-pattern review to doc.
infra-oncall: will notify pager 30m before apply. thanks team.
rachael: follow-up sync scheduled 2026-04-01 09:00 PT to confirm closures. update PM doc when tasks complete. thanks!
